title: 9.6 Solving Right Triangles

icans: I can use an inverse trigonometric ratio to find an angle measure.
I can solve a right triangle by finding all of its side lengths and angle measures.
I can solve real-life problems with right triangles.

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: the calculator works backward

blocks.p: Draw each right triangle. At the end of the longer leg, measure the acute angle with a protractor. Then find tan⁻¹(opposite ÷ adjacent) on the calculator.
